entries.tactical_failure_mode_quoted: The recurring failure is treating the partition criterion itself as the contribution while leaving its value unproven. Papers propose a sensitivity or redundancy discriminator — roundtrip distortion, weight magnitude, activation overlap, double-rounding, subspace projection — and reviewers immediately map it onto an established technique (PCA/SVD on activations, a layer-norm-equivalent rescaling, structured dropout, classical feature distillation), so the differentiated treatment reads as a relabeling rather than a new mechanism.

entries.tactical_pattern_quoted: This cluster compresses an over-provisioned trained artifact — model weights, intermediate activations, the KV/state buffer, the sampling trajectory, or a dataset — by exploiting heterogeneity in its components rather than applying one uniform lossy operation. The concrete move: discriminate components by a magnitude-, sensitivity-, influence-, or redundancy-based criterion into a high-impact minority and a near-redundant bulk, then preserve, migrate, residually correct, or retain-at-full-precision the minority while aggressively quantizing, pruning, factorizing, or distilling the bulk.
